 News › News News › November School Holidays 2026: Check Diwali, Guru Nanak Jayanti and state wise holiday list November School Holidays 2026: Check Diwali, Guru Nanak Jayanti and state wise holiday list
 Ashita Kashyap Updated: Oct 26, 2026, 12:30 IST ​November School Holidays 2026 School holidays in November 2026 will be different across India. The dates depend on state government notices, school schedules and local celebrations. Diwali will be on November 8, Guru Nanak Jayanti will be on November 24.
 In Maharashtra, schools will have a 13-day Diwali break from November 2 to November 14. For the same students and parents are advised to check the holiday calendar from their school before making plans for trips or other events.
 School holidays in November 2026: What students should know
 November 2026 will bring festival‑related holidays for school students across India. I know that not every festival will cause a school closure in every state. The dates for vacations, local festivals and other holidays can differ depending on state education department orders and each school calendar.
 According to holiday lists published by government organisations Diwali falls on Sunday, November 8 and Guru Nanak Jayanti falls on Tuesday, November 24. Both the dates are included in the 2026 gazetted holiday calendar published by the Comptroller and Auditor General of India.
 Students should remember that a public holiday for government offices does not automatically mean every school will remain closed. The final decision depends on the state or school notification.
 Diwali school holidays in November 2026: Check the dates 
 Diwali will be celebrated on November 8 2026. Schools might start their vacation before the festival and keep it going for several days after depending on the state.
 Maharashtra has declared a 13-day vacation for recognised primary, secondary and higher secondary schools. The vacation will run from November 2 to November 14, 2026. According to a report published by a renowned media house on October 22 classes are set to resume on Monday, November 16.
 The holiday period includes festive days such as Dhanteras, Diwali and Bhaubij. This schedule is only for the Maharashtra school calendar and should not be seen as a national holiday announcement.
 In states schools may have different vacation dates. Importantly, parents should check circulars issued by their schools or the state education departments before planning any travel.
 Guru Nanak Jayanti school holiday on November 24, 2026 
 Guru Nanak Jayanti, also known as Gurpurab, will be observed on Tuesday, November 24, 2026. 
 The festival marks the birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev, the founder of Sikhism.
 The day is included in the central government’s 2026 gazetted holiday list. Schools in states and regions that declare a holiday for the occasion may remain closed.
 However, the holiday may not apply uniformly across India for the same students should confirm the date with their schools, particularly if they have examinations, practical classes or other scheduled academic activities.
 November 2026 school holiday calendar: Important dates 
 Here are the key dates students and parents should keep in mind while planning the month.
 Date Day Holiday 
 November 2-14 Monday-Saturday Maharashtra's reported Diwali vacation 
 November 8 Sunday Diwali (Deepavali) 
 November 10 Tuesday Diwali Amavasya-related/ Bali Pratipada holiday in Maharashtra's public holiday calendar 
 November 24 Tuesday Guru Nanak Jayanti (Punjab) 
 The above table shows the Maharashtra vacation dates are based on the reported state school schedule. However, the festival dates and state holiday arrangements should be checked against the applicable official notification.
 November 8 is already a Sunday, therefore students whose schools normally remain closed on Sundays will not receive an additional weekday off for that date alone.
 Will schools remain closed across India in November 2026?
 There is no nationwide school holiday calendar that determines every school closure in November. Government schools, schools, central schools and state‑board institutions may follow different schedules.
 Some schools may observe Diwali vacations while others may reopen earlier. Regional festivals and local administrative orders can also lead to holidays. In some areas schools may announce closures because of circumstances but these should not be assumed without an official notice.
 Students preparing for board examinations or entrance tests should also check whether classes, revision sessions or practical examinations will continue during the festival period.
 How to check the official school holiday list for November 2026? 
 To avoid confusion, students and parents should the following steps:
 Check the school's academic calendar or latest circular.
 Visit the relevant state education department's official website.
 Confirm the Diwali vacation dates with the school administration.
 Check for district-level orders that may affect school timings or closures.
 Confirm reopening dates before booking tickets or planning family trips.
 November 2026 will include major festival dates such as Diwali and Guru Nanak Jayanti, along with state-specific school vacations. Maharashtra has a reported Diwali break from November 2 to 14, but students in other states should rely on their own school's official schedule rather than assume the same dates apply nationwide.
